name: Divani Caravel
description: One of Athens’ most emblematic hotels, Divani Caravel combines upscale style with elegant urban living, excellent facilities, and top-class service. Voted multiple times as Greece’s Leading City Hotel by the World Travel Awards, it is located just minutes away from Syntagma Square and the fashionable Kolonaki, rendering the ideal base for sightseeing. Dine at JuJu Bar & Restaurant, a sophisticated, modern venue with art deco environment during winter and an unmatched city panorama during summer. Finally, work out at the rooftop Fitness Center, the only one in Athens with a cityscape view, next to the swimming pool, where you may relish snacks & drinks at the Thea Poolside Bar.
